description:
Owner's law (2026-07-02): follow_up is an anti-northstar SMELL — a job imperatively enqueueing other jobs is control-flow smuggled into a dataflow engine. The northstar admits exactly two reasons work runs: a consumer WAITS on a named fact/product (pull), or a CHANGED REVISION wakes a recorded reader. Owner's sharpening (2026-07-02): "if a push-based / pass-based idea is being smuggled back in under a different name, that's a violation of the spirit of the pull/demand based approach. period." No push survives by being rebranded (cache, batch, seed, first-run exception); if a push is load-bearing, the fix is extending the pull mechanism to cover the case, never blessing the push.

DOC ALIGNMENT (2026-07-02, northstar.html + pull-based.html read in full): the blanket rule is pull-based.html's Non-negotiable ("A consumer must not schedule an arbitrary producer to save itself"; "Follow-up producer poke: Forbidden ... legacy code can remain only until the replacement is proven and deleted"). northstar.html still tolerates follow_up for legacy jobs; this arc is the doc-anticipated retirement of that tolerance, and northstar.html's clause gets updated when this lands.

FAMILY 1 — DONE (e561842ce): seed_root's LowerFunction/PlanEntryDispatch pushes proven always-coalesced (their producers' fact chains guarantee both jobs already ran) and deleted. Three-lane audited, static proof airtight.

FAMILY 2 — DONE-partial (724350b1b): the previous "KEEP: genuine first-run demand" classification of the AnalyzeActivation pushes was DISPROVEN and both sites were investigated under the no-smuggling rule.
- seed_activation:108's push: PROVEN REDUNDANT and DELETED. seed_activation is only ever demanded via demand_product_fact_producer's arms (Activation/ActivationInputs, ActivationAnalyzed/ReturnType, CallSiteSummary/CallSiteTargets), and every arm that reaches it co-demands AnalyzeActivation for the same activation in the same call. The plain Activation/ActivationInputs-only branch has zero production callers (grep-verified across pull.rs/artifact.rs/backend.rs/runtime_demand.rs).
- seed_root:81's push: KEPT, with the precise gap documented in a short code comment. On every PRODUCT-driven path (interp/JIT/native/dump) it is provably redundant — empirically confirmed (byte-identical stdout, identical AnalyzeActivation/SeedRoot/SeedActivation job-start counts with the push removed). But Compiler2::drive()/World::drive_for() is a second first-class public entry point running the bare job-graph scheduler with NO product demanded, and that scheduler has NO FactKey->producer demand-on-stall mechanism — removing the push broke 19 tests (drive_test, transport_contract_test, fixture_facts_test, port_frontend_test, port_resolve_test). This is a named architectural gap, not a justification: the pull model doesn't yet cover the bare-scheduler entry point.

FAMILY 3 — THE KEYSTONE (next): generalize the product boundary's fact->producer demand map (demand_product_fact_producer, currently duplicated in compiler.rs:336-370 and jobs/backend.rs:149-184 — the duplication itself is fz-go4.19's target) into the core scheduler so drive_for demands-on-stall: when the agenda drains with waiters still blocked on an unproduced fact, the scheduler consults the map and demands the producer, exactly as the product driver does. After this lands, seed_root's last push deletes trivially, and every remaining absence-gated wait+demand emission site (the FAMILY 4+ inventory below) converts mechanically. This is scheduler.rs/drive.rs-shaped design work; sequence fz-go4.18.31 (AnalyzeActivation churn batching) AFTER it since both touch the same wake paths.

FAMILY 4+ INVENTORY (from the .18.19 removable-code audit; production emissions): jobs/body.rs (~72 refs — DeriveTypeDef, ReifyGuardDispatch pushes from lowering), jobs/semantic.rs (~66), jobs/dispatch.rs, jobs/keying.rs, jobs/contract.rs, jobs/types.rs, jobs/source.rs, source_publish.rs, quoted_expander.rs, world.rs. Product-side jobs (artifact/runtime_demand/transport/backend/native) emit ZERO follow_ups already. Work consumers-backward per family, one commit per family; prefer static producer/wait-graph proofs over raw job-trace count diffing (counts are run-to-run noisy per .28.5's evidence).

TELEMETRY GAP: pull-based.html prescribes session-level proof — follow_ups=0/root_scans=0 on a session-finished event. The product path's ["fz","compiler2","pull","session","finished"] event carries executables/producer_pokes but no follow_ups counter, and the legacy scheduler has only per-step coalesced lists (noisy). Add an aggregate follow-up-emission counter as this arc's DONE-verification before declaring the final family complete.

WATCH ITEMS: (1) semantic.rs:1255-1258 demands DefineModule(protocol) while waiting on ProtocolDispatch — resolve the real producer relationship during migration; (2) the coalesced-telemetry channel conflates agenda-dedupe with standing-conclusion suppression (scheduler.rs:257 vs :228-232) — split when this lands.

DONE = rg shows zero production follow_up emissions; JobEffects::follow_up field deleted; the .18.19 coalesce screen deleted; scheduler wake paths = changed-revision only (plus the one axiomatic submit_root->SeedRoot injection at world.rs:367, the single external ignition a pull tree requires); docs updated (fact-engine.md drops 'legacy jobs may enqueue follow-ups'; northstar.html's tolerance clause updated). Blocked by nothing — family 3 is ready to start.

comments.text: STARTING INVENTORY from the .18.19 removable-code audit (2026-07-02, at 424b2ae6a): (1) FIRST REMOVAL, proof complete: seed_root's LowerFunction + PlanEntryDispatch follow_ups (root.rs:75-76) are provably ALWAYS-COALESCED — the concluding branch requires Recursive+DispatchMask facts, whose producers (keying.rs:148-152 -> body.rs:287; keying.rs:84-90 -> dispatch.rs:169) must therefore have concluded; first-run demand already lives in DeriveRecursive/DeriveDispatchMask; change waves handle re-runs. Safe to delete as this arc's first family (own commit). (2) KEEP-classified: root.rs:77/:112 AnalyzeActivation (genuine first-run demand for a just-minted activation); ALL other emissions are absence-gated wait+demand pairs (semantic.rs:219/1257/1301/1492/1647/2265, dispatch, body, keying, source, world.rs:2094/2102, quoted_expander, source_publish) — these are the wait-implies-demand conversion targets. (3) Product-side jobs (artifact/runtime_demand/transport/backend/native) emit ZERO follow_ups already. (4) Minor: the coalesced telemetry channel conflates agenda-dedupe (scheduler.rs:257) with standing-conclusion suppression (scheduler.rs:228-232) — split the observability when this arc lands. (5) Watch item from the cross-lane note: semantic.rs:1255-1258 demands DefineModule(protocol) while waiting on ProtocolDispatch — the one site where a follow_up forced a concluded job's re-run as a wait-unblocking mechanism; resolve its real producer relationship during migration.

title: Migrate the semantic layer off follow_up: work runs only via waits (pull) or changed-revision wakes
